title: OpenSSH agent forwarding untrusted-search-path code execution
description: Older OpenSSH versions load PKCS#11 modules from an untrusted path via agent forwarding.

title: Apache HTTP Server path traversal / RCE
description: Path traversal in Apache 2.4.49/2.4.50 can expose files outside the document root and, with CGI enabled, allow remote code execution.
remediation: Upgrade Apache httpd to 2.4.51 or later.

title: nginx resolver off-by-one heap write
description: A DNS resolver off-by-one in nginx may allow memory corruption.
remediation: Upgrade nginx to 1.21.0 or later (fix backported to 1.20.1).

title: OpenSSL X.509 punycode buffer overflow
description: A buffer overflow in X.509 certificate verification (punycode) in OpenSSL 3.0.x before 3.0.7.

title: vsftpd 2.3.4 backdoor
description: A backdoored build of vsftpd 2.3.4 opens a root shell on port 6200.
remediation: Reinstall vsftpd from a trusted source; upgrade to a current version.

title: ProFTPD mod_copy unauthenticated file copy
description: The mod_copy module in ProFTPD before 1.3.5a allows unauthenticated SITE CPFR/CPTO file copy.
remediation: Upgrade ProFTPD to 1.3.5a+ or disable mod_copy.

title: Samba SambaCry remote code execution
description: Samba before 4.6.4/4.5.10/4.4.14 allows a writable share client to load and execute a shared library (EternalRed).
remediation: Upgrade Samba, or set 'nt pipe support = no'.

title: IIS 6.0 WebDAV ScStoragePathFromUrl buffer overflow
description: A buffer overflow in the WebDAV service of IIS 6.0 allows remote code execution via a long header.
remediation: IIS 6.0 is end-of-life; migrate to a supported Windows Server / IIS version.
